data.name: VAGUE
data.detailed_description:
"After a sudden and unnerving car accident, Ray finds his family is nowhere to be seen..."

VAGUE is a first person psychological horror inspired by early 2000s classic horror titles. You follow Raymond, a middle-aged man in his search for his missing family.

Navigate these haunting place, piece together fragments of forgotten memories, and confront the shadows of the past to find and uncover his family's fate.

Key Features:

  • Dark And Surreal Visuals: Presented in a style of early 2000s indie films, dive into a atmospheric world of terror and discomfort, crafted by a fusion of what's rooted in the mind.

  • Challenging Cryptic Puzzles: Test your wits with diverse and engaging puzzles that require keen observation, creative thinking, and problem-solving in order to solve them.

  • Eerie Encounters: Confront a variety of supernatural entities, each with their unique appearances and behaviors, reflecting the fears and traumas of the mind.

  • Evolving narrative: Piece together a complex and compelling story, gradually uncovering the chilling past and hidden truths that lie within.

"Will he push through this nightmarish ordeal, or will he be trapped in its dark embrace forever?"

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4000 series or AMD Ryzen™ 5 3600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1050 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard HD audio device
  • Additional Notes: This game features Dynamic Resolution. Please note that NVIDIA® DLSS is exclusive to RTX series cards, while AMD FSR 2 works on any graphics card that supports compute shaders.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4000 series or AMD Ryzen™ 5 3600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX 3060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard HD audio device
  • Additional Notes: This game features Dynamic Resolution. Please note that NVIDIA® DLSS is exclusive to RTX series cards, while AMD FSR 2 works on any graphics card that supports compute shaders.
